in_sanskrit.name: अद्वैत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The philosophical concept of non-dualism or monism in Hinduism and Buddhism, which asserts that the ultimate reality is beyond the duality of the phenomenal world.

in_hindi.long_meaning: अद्वेष्य (Adveshya) is a synonym for Advaith in Hindi, which means 'non-enemy'. However, it is important to note that the modern name 'Advaith' is specifically derived from the philosophical concept of Advaita Vedanta.

in_telugu.name: అద్వైత
in_telugu.long_meaning: అద్వైథ (Advaitha) is the Telugu translation of Advaith, which also means 'non-dual'.

in_marathi.name: Advaith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Advaith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Advaith means 'non-dual'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'advaita', which signifies the ultimate reality that is beyond duality. In Hindu philosophy, it is the concept of oneness, representing the absolute truth and the ultimate goal of spiritual enlightenment.
